reply.text:
You didn’t undo your recovery.

Three pizza nights is not a bone-healing disaster. It’s just three meals that were probably heavy on salt/refined carbs and light on the stuff your body actually needs to rebuild. The fix is boring and simple:

| What to do now | Why it helps |
|---|---|
| Eat a proper protein-forward breakfast today | Gives your body the raw materials for repair |
| Get calcium + vitamin D in your next 2–3 meals | Bone healing needs both |
| Add fruit/veg to every meal today | Micronutrients and overall recovery support |
| Drink water normally | Pizza is salty; don’t let dehydration stack on top |
| Get back to a regular meal rhythm | No compensation, no starving, no “making up for it” |
| Prioritize sleep tonight | Probably the highest-return recovery tool you have |

A good rule for the next 24 hours: just aim for one solid recovery day, not perfection.

If you want, I can give you a very simple “reset day” menu for today using normal food, nothing fussy.
